comparison.objective: Thread and hand-tighten a spin-on oil filter to a prescribed angle after gasket contact; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests thread engagement, sustained rotation, contact detection, and torque/angle restraint. Candidate tests constrained linear blade insertion and latch-mediated axial withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a final tightening-angle window without unthreading or over-compressing the gasket. Candidate requires selective terminal exit without crimp, housing, tool, or neighbor damage.
comparison.reason: Threaded installation and tang-release extraction use different motions, mechanisms, and failure modes.
